title: Server Monitoring
description: Landing page for the monitoring dashboards. Visual theme: Sunset Orange.

options.content:
Start with the cards, then open a section from the links at the top of the page.

**Needs another integration:** Docker container CPU, memory, and restarts need cAdvisor. Database query rates and connections need a database exporter. Backup success is not collected. Those three pages say so instead of showing a false healthy state.

panels.title: Server health
panels.description: One row per server. Health is Healthy when CPU, memory, and disk are under 80%, swap is under 50%, and load is within CPU capacity. Warning means one of those is high. Critical means a resource is over 90% or a service has failed. Offline means Node Exporter cannot be scraped. Disk is the fullest data filesystem, excluding the small EFI partition. Open a server name for detail.
